classification.difficultyReason: Use tangent to find the shared height, add the two labelled baseline segments and apply inverse tangent in the larger triangle; both intermediate targets are supplied.

spec.description: Two right triangles share a vertical height; the consecutive baseline segments are 15 m and 10 m.
spec.mathematics: The inner triangle has adjacent side 10 m and angle 17 degrees. The outer triangle has adjacent side 25 m and angle theta.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown labels are visible.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Find the value of $h$, correct to the nearest centimetre.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Hence find the value of $\theta$, correct to the nearest degree.

answer.worked:
The complete baseline is $15+10=25\text{ m}$. Retain the unrounded value of $h$.
$$\begin{align*}\tan\theta&=\frac{10\tan17^\circ}{25}\\\theta&=\tan^{-1}\!\left(\frac{10\tan17^\circ}{25}\right)\\\theta&\approx7^\circ\end{align*}$$
